description: Point d'eau potable - Tarn-et-Garonne is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Openstreetmap. Point d’accès à l'eau potable issus d'OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Données territoriales. Its keywords are point d'eau, eau potable, infrastructure. The portal shows 82 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
